title: In Taiwan, Turning Trash into Sunglasses (2/2)
titleZh: 在台灣，把垃圾變成太陽眼鏡 (2/2)
summaryZh: 台灣的回收工作坊讓民眾反思垃圾問題，學著少用塑膠、多做回收。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — As It Is

sentences.text: As for consumers, it is important for them to get first-hand experience, so a workshop like this is very helpful, she said.
sentences.zh: 至於消費者，親身體驗很重要，所以像這樣的工作坊很有幫助，她說。

sentences.text: People taking part in the workshop said it made them think twice about producing trash and made them pay more attention to reusable goods.
sentences.zh: 參加工作坊的人說，這讓他們對製造垃圾這件事多想了一下，也更注意可重複使用的物品。

sentences.text: I need to think about their future, said business owner Debbie Wu.
sentences.zh: 我得為他們的未來著想，企業主 Debbie Wu 說。

sentences.text: If you throw away trash without thinking, you kick the problem down the road.
sentences.zh: 如果你不加思索就把垃圾丟掉，等於是把問題留給以後。

sentences.text: So if everyone can do their best, recycle and use less plastic, that will make a big difference, Wu said.
sentences.zh: 所以只要每個人都盡一份力，做回收、少用塑膠，就會有很大的改變，吳女士說。
